query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parentId,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_posts bp WHERE bp.categoryId = c.id AND bp.status='published') as direct_posts
FROM blog_categories c
WHERE c.parentId IS NULL
ORDER BY direct_posts DESC;
